title: Electro-Optical Metalens for Near-Surface Cooling of a Levitated Particle
summary: Advanced levitation optomechanics in the quantum regime requires sophisticated quantumengineered protocols operating at shorter length and time scales, demanding an increasing control over both optical and electrical potentials. Integrated chip-scale platforms offer a natural route toward such control. Here, we demonstrate optical levitation in vacuum using a miniaturized hybrid electro-optical metalens. Motion control is achieved using a high numerical aperture metalens combined with electrical active feedback using planar electrodes, enabling cooling to low phonon occupations. Reheating…
